title: Warsaw protest against the New Year movement restriction at Rondo de Gaulle’a
continuation_into_unit_month: physically observed at midnight 2021-01-01; later physical end unknown
organizer: Obywatele RP and activists from Ogólnopolski Strajk Kobiet, as reported by OKO.press
participants_original: No crowd count in the opened contemporary account; the threshold of 50 is unresolved.
threshold_50_evidence: The opened report identifies multiple protesters and their continued presence at midnight but supplies no count; it does not establish 50 participants. Counts for the separate “Sylwester u Kaczora” gathering cannot be transferred.

start_date.summary: Contemporary report dates the event Dec31 and says it began around 18:30.

location.summary: The reported protest was at Rondo de Gaulle in Warsaw; a separate nearby New Year event is described independently.

organizer.summary: Report attributes the gathering to Obywatele RP and Ogólnopolski Women’s Strike activists.

demands.summary: Participants objected to the government’s New Year movement restriction and its legal basis.

continuation_into_unit_month.summary: The reporter records the gathering still present at midnight welcoming the New Year while surrounded by a police cordon; physical presence therefore crosses into Jan1.

participants_original.summary: No attendance estimate or count is stated for this gathering.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count establishes the 50-person threshold; do not transfer figures from the separate Żoliborz event.

state_arrests.summary: The report says police took one person to the station after the person set off a flare outside the cordon.

state_crowd_dispersal.summary: Police called for people to leave and formed a cordon; they allowed departure only after identification, and some attendees left by about 20:30.

end_date.summary: The report still observes the gathering at midnight and does not record a later physical departure or dissolution; end remains unknown.

notes: Prior-onset boundary continuation, not a January-onset event. The report verifies that the same Rondo gathering remained physically present at midnight Jan1, but does not establish >=50. End date is deliberately unknown. A retrospective search-only ObyPomoc lead (S048) mentions over six hours but its body could not be opened and does not set an end here.
open_questions: Find a body-accessible source or independent count establishing whether the gathering reached 50.
Establish when participants physically departed or the gathering dissolved after midnight.
